node.statement: Corner product estimates. From node 1.1.2, the amplified target projections have ||p_i||<=2 and ||p_1p_2||,||p_2p_1||<=4e, and each compressed-corner element is within c_c e times its norm of either corresponding left-right supported representative, for one universal c_c from def-compressed-corner. Thus, if U in M_n tensor S_{P_j,P_k} and V in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m} with k!=l, replace U,V by p_j(Up_k), p_l(Vp_m), insert p_kp_l, and use twice the epsilon-associator and the product-norm axiom; the replacement, reassociation, and middle-product errors give ||UV||<=K_inc e||U||||V|| for a universal K_inc. If k=l, def-compressed-corner gives ||UV-U dot V||<=c_c e||U||||V||. All constants are amplification- and dimension-independent.
